a.ID, a.PRICEREQNO, a.APPNO, a.APPNAME, a.PROJECTNAME, a.RENEWPROCESSNO, TO_CHAR(a.EXPECTEDONLINETIME,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS EXPECTEDONLINETIME, a.ISCMDBUSED, a.AMOUNT, a.STATUS, a.STATUSTIME, a.CREATORNAME || '(' || a.CREATOR || ')' AS CREATOR, TO_CHAR(a.CREATETIME,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CREATETIME, a.SOURCETYPE, a.BUSIDEPTID, a.TECHDEPTID, a.BUSIDEPTNAME, a.TECHDEPTNAME, a.SYSOPERLEVEL, a.ISFUNDTRANS, a.PROJECTNO, a.BUDGETNO, a.PROCESSINSTID, a.CIID, a.DOCMID
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM RES_ADDED a
a.PRICEREQNO LIKE '%'||#{priceReqNo}||'%' AND a.APPNAME LIKE '%'||#{appName}||'%' AND a.APPNO = #{appNo} AND a.PROJECTNAME LIKE '%'|| #{projectName}||'%' AND a.BUSIDEPTID = #{busiDeptId} AND a.TECHDEPTID = #{techDeptId} AND a.STATUS = #{status} AND a.CREATORNAME || '(' || a.CREATOR || ')' LIKE '%'||#{creator}||'%' AND
a.CREATETIME >= TO_DATE(#{startTime},'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND
a.CREATETIME < TO_DATE(#{endTime},'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')+1 AND
a.EXPECTEDONLINETIME >= TO_DATE(#{expectedOnlineStartTime},'YYYY-MM-DD') AND
a.EXPECTEDONLINETIME < TO_DATE(#{expectedOnlineEndTime},'YYYY-MM-DD')+1 AND
a.sourceType=#{sourceType}
ORDER BY A.CREATETIME DESC

SELECT DISTINCT t.*, CASE WHEN PCODE = '9000000000' THEN 'order1' ELSE 'order2' END ORDER_BY FROM ( SELECT a.* FROM ( SELECT 'org' || t.COMPID ID, t.COMPCODE PCODE, t.LOCATION TEXT, 'org' || t.ADMINID PID, 'org' ATTR, '' TEXTPY FROM COMM_ORGANIZATION t WHERE t.ISDISABLED = '0' UNION ALL SELECT 'dep' || t.DEPID ID, t.DEPCODE PCODE, t.LOCATION TEXT, 'org' || t.COMPID PID, 'dep' ATTR, '' TEXTPY FROM COMM_DEPARTMENT t WHERE t.ADMINID IS NULL AND t.ISDISABLED = '0' UNION ALL SELECT 'dep' || t.DEPID ID, t.DEPCODE PCODE, t.LOCATION TEXT, 'dep' || t.ADMINID PID, 'dep' ATTR, '' TEXTPY FROM COMM_DEPARTMENT t WHERE t.ADMINID IS NOT NULL AND t.ISDISABLED = '0' UNION ALL SELECT 'sys' || x.RES_ID, x.SYSTEM_ID PCODE, x.SYS_NAME TEXT, CASE WHEN x.P_RES_ID IS NULL THEN 'dep' || x.TEC_DEP ELSE 'sys' || x.P_RES_ID END PID, 'sys' ATTR, '' TEXTPY FROM ( SELECT a.RES_ID, NVL(b.SYSTEM_ID, a.RES_ID) SYSTEM_ID, b.SYS_NAME, a.TEC_DEP, c.LOCATION, b.P_RES_ID FROM AAP_SYSTEM_RESPONSIBILITY a LEFT JOIN COMM_DEPARTMENT c ON a.TEC_DEP = c.DEPID RIGHT JOIN AAP_SYSTEM b on a.RES_ID = b.RES_ID AND b.SYS_NAME IS NOT NULL WHERE 1 = 1 AND b.P_RES_ID IS NULL AND b.SYS_STATUS = 1 ) x ) a ) t START WITH t.ATTR = 'sys' CONNECT BY PRIOR t.PID = t.ID ORDER BY ORDER_BY, ID

SELECT a.TEC_DEP,a.TEC_DEP_NAME,a.BUS_DEP,a.BUS_DEP_NAME,b.OM_LEVEL,b.REFMONEY,b.CIID FROM AAP_SYSTEM_RESPONSIBILITY a RIGHT JOIN AAP_SYSTEM b ON a.RES_ID = b.RES_ID AND b.SYS_NAME IS NOT NULL WHERE NVL(b.SYSTEM_ID, a.RES_ID) = #{pcode}

SELECT ( SELECT DICTNAME FROM EOS_DICT_ENTRY s WHERE s.dictid=t.PRODUCTIONNETWORK AND s.DICTTYPEID='IPSQ_PRODUCTIONNETWORK' ) AS PRODUCTIONNETWORK, t.NETWORKAREA, t.ID FROM PPM_IPSQ_CONFIG_WLQY t WHERE t.ISDEL='0' ORDER BY t.PRODUCTIONNETWORK,t.NETWORKAREA ASC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT s.DEPTNO AS ID, (SELECT LOCATION FROM COMM_DEPARTMENT WHERE DEPID = s.DEPTNO) AS TEXT, '-1' AS PID, '' BUSIUSERID, '' MANAUSERID, '' MANAUSERNAME, '' EMPNAME, TO_DATE('') EXPECTDATE, '' SYSNO, '' SYSNAME FROM PPM_PROJECT_BUILD_SOFT s WHERE s.STATUS IS NOT NULL AND s.ISDEL = '0'
UNION
SELECT PROJECTNO AS ID, PROJECTNAME AS TEXT, DEPTNO as PID, BUSIUSERID, MANAUSERID, em.EMPNAME MANAUSERNAME, e.EMPNAME, EXPECTDATE, p.SYSNO, s.SYS_NAME SYSNAME FROM PPM_PROJECT_BUILD_SOFT p LEFT JOIN COMM_EMPLOYEE em ON p.MANAUSERID = em.BADGE LEFT JOIN COMM_EMPLOYEE e ON p.BUSIUSERID = e.BADGE LEFT JOIN AAP_SYSTEM s on p.SYSNO = s.SYSTEM_ID WHERE STATUS IS NOT NULL
AND STATUS <> '全部上线' AND STATUS <> '已关闭' AND STATUS <> '项目终止'
AND ISDEL = '0' ) WHERE PID IS NOT NULL AND ID IS NOT NULL

SELECT a.NODETYPE, a.MODELTYPE AS DICTID, b.DICTNAME, a.MODELCONFIGTYPE FROM RES_SELECTION_CONFIG a LEFT JOIN EOS_DICT_ENTRY b ON a.MODELTYPE = b.DICTID WHERE b.DICTTYPEID = 'RES_MODELTYPE' AND a.NODETYPE = #{nodeType} AND a.MODELTYPE = #{modelType}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT b.ID, a.DICTID, b.APPLYSCENE, b.DESCRIBE, b.PRICE, b.STATUS, '1' AS CATEGORY, b.ISCANCEL FROM EOS_DICT_ENTRY a LEFT JOIN RES_CONFIG_COMBO b ON a.DICTID = b.SUBCATEGORY WHERE a.DICTTYPEID = 'RES_SUBCATEGORY' AND a.PARENTID = '2' UNION ALL SELECT ID, TO_CHAR(TYPE) AS DICTID, '' AS APPLYSCENE, DESCRIBE, PRICE, STATUS, '2' AS CATEGORY, ISCANCEL FROM RES_CONFIG_VM ) WHERE STATUS = '2'
SELECT * FROM RES_CONFIG_SOFT t WHERE t.STATUS='2'

SELECT t.ID, s.DICTNAME AS CATEGORY, t.APPLYSCENE, t.DESCRIBE, t.PRICE, t.CPUNUM, t.CPUCORE, t.DISKCAPACITY, t.ISCANCEL FROM RES_CONFIG_COMBO t LEFT JOIN EOS_DICT_ENTRY s ON t.SUBCATEGORY=s.DICTID WHERE t.CATEGORY = #{category} AND t.SUBCATEGORY = #{subcategory} AND t.ISSPECIAL=#{isSpecial} AND t.STATUS='2' AND s.DICTTYPEID='RES_SUBCATEGORY'
SELECT * FROM RES_CONFIG_COMBO WHERE ID =#{id}

SELECT ID,PRICEREQNO,APPNO,APPNAME,PROJECTNAME,PROJECTNO,TO_CHAR(EXPECTEDONLINETIME,'YYYY-MM-DD') EXPECTEDONLINETIME,AMOUNT, STATUS,CREATOR,TO_CHAR(CREATETIME,'YYYY-MM-DD') CREATETIME,CREATORNAME,SOURCETYPE,BUSIDEPTNAME,TECHDEPTNAME,SYSOPERLEVEL, ISFUNDTRANS,ISCMDBUSED,BUDGETNO,RENEWPROCESSNO,CIID,BUSIDEPTID,TECHDEPTID,SYSDEALUSER,PROCESSINSTID,DOCMID FROM RES_ADDED where id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE RES_ADDED SET PRICEREQNO=#{priceReqNo},APPNO =#{appNo},APPNAME=#{appName}, PROJECTNAME=#{projectName}, PROJECTNO=#{projectNo}, EXPECTEDONLINETIME=TO_DATE(#{expectedOnlineTime},'YYYY-MM-DD'), AMOUNT=#{amount},STATUS=#{status},SOURCETYPE=#{sourceType},BUSIDEPTNAME=#{busiDeptName},TECHDEPTNAME=#{techDeptName}, SYSOPERLEVEL=#{sysOperLevel}, ISFUNDTRANS=#{isFundTrans}, PROCESSINSTID=#{processInstID}, CIID=#{ciid},BUSIDEPTID=#{busiDeptId},TECHDEPTID=#{techDeptId}, DOCMID=#{docmId} WHERE ID = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT ID,PRICEREQNO,APPNO,APPNAME,PROJECTNAME,PROJECTNO,TO_CHAR(EXPECTEDONLINETIME,'YYYY-MM-DD') EXPECTEDONLINETIME,AMOUNT, STATUS,CREATOR,TO_CHAR(CREATETIME,'YYYY-MM-DD') CREATETIME,CREATORNAME,SOURCETYPE,BUSIDEPTNAME,TECHDEPTNAME,SYSOPERLEVEL, ISFUNDTRANS,ISCMDBUSED,BUDGETNO,RENEWPROCESSNO from RES_ADDED where PROCESSINSTID=#{processInstId}
SELECT t.ID, t.APPLYSCENE, t.PRICE, t.RATIO, t.DEVOPSLEVEL, t.ISRELATEFUND, t.ISSPECIAL, t.SUBCATEGORY, t.ISCANCEL FROM RES_CONFIG_COMBO t WHERE t.STATUS='2' AND t.ID=#{id}

SELECT
FROM RES_ADDED a where a.EXPECTEDONLINETIME = TO_DATE(#{noticeDateStr},'YYYY-MM-DD')
SELECT * FROM RES_ADDED_ITEM WHERE ADDEDID= #{addedId} ORDER BY SOFTID
SELECT * FROM RES_ADDED_ITEM_PARTS WHERE ADDEDITEMID =#{addedItemId}
SELECT * FROM RES_ADDED_ITEM_VERSION WHERE ADDEDITEMID =#{addedItemId}
SELECT DISKCAPACITY FROM RES_CONFIG_COMBO WHERE ID=#{id}

SELECT APPLYCODE, FLOWTITLE, FLOWSTATUS FROM (SELECT T.APPLYCODE, PPF.FLOWTITLE, PPF.FLOWSTATUS FROM PPM_DEMAND_CHANGE T LEFT JOIN PPM_PROJECT_FLOW PPF ON T.INSTANCEID = PPF.INSTANCEID WHERE T.APPLYCODE IS NOT NULL AND PPF.INSTANCEID IS NOT NULL AND PPF.FLOWSTATUS != '已删除' UNION SELECT T.FAULTNO, PPF.FLOWTITLE, PPF.FLOWSTATUS FROM PPM_SCIFAULT_INFO T LEFT JOIN PPM_PROJECT_FLOW PPF ON T.INSTANCEID = PPF.INSTANCEID WHERE PPF.INSTANCEID IS NOT NULL AND PPF.FLOWSTATUS != '已删除') a
a.applycode like '%'||#{applyCode}||'%' AND a.flowtitle like '%'||#{flowTitle}||'%' AND

SELECT #{ownCenterName} || '中心' AS OWNCENTERNAME, '虚拟机资源' AS TYPE, SUM(cpu) || 'C' || SUM(memory) || 'G' || SUM(disk) || 'G' AS DESCRIPTION, '/' AS COUNT, '/' AS PRICE, SUM(totalPrice) AS TOTALPRICE FROM ( SELECT SUM(CPU) AS CPU , SUM(MEMORY) AS MEMORY, SUM(DISK) As DISK, SUM(TOTALPRICE) AS TOTALPRICE FROM (SELECT NVL((SELECT SUM(a.num) FROM RES_ADDED_ITEM_PARTS a WHERE a.RESCONFIGID = 1 and a.ADDEDITEMID = m.ID GROUP BY a.PARTID,a.NUM),0) AS CPU,
NVL((SELECT SUM(a.num) FROM RES_ADDED_ITEM_PARTS a WHERE a.RESCONFIGID = 2 and a.ADDEDITEMID = m.ID GROUP BY a.PARTID,a.NUM),0) AS MEMORY,
NVL((SELECT SUM(a.num) FROM RES_ADDED_ITEM_PARTS a WHERE a.RESCONFIGID = 3 AND a.ADDEDITEMID = m.ID GROUP BY a.PARTID,a.NUM),0) AS DISK,
m.HARDWARETOTALPRICE AS TOTALPRICE FROM RES_ADDED_ITEM m WHERE m.ADDEDID = #{id} AND m.OWNCENTER = #{ownCenter} AND m.MODELTYPE = 2)
UNION ALL
SELECT NVL(SUM(b.CPUNUM),0) AS CPU, NVL(sum(b.MEMORY),0) AS MEMORY, NVL(SUM(B.DISKCAPACITY),0) AS DISK, NVL(SUM(A.COMBOTOTALPRICE),0) AS TOTALPRICE FROM RES_ADDED_ITEM a LEFT JOIN RES_CONFIG_COMBO b ON a.MODELCONFIG = b.ID WHERE a.ADDEDID = #{id} AND a.OWNCENTER = #{ownCenter} AND a.MODELTYPE = 2 )

SELECT #{ownCenterName} || '中心' AS OWNCENTERNAME, '物理机套餐' AS TYPE, a.MODELCONFIGNAME AS DESCRIPTION, COUNT(a.MODELCONFIG) AS COUNT, a.COMBOTOTALPRICE AS PRICE, SUM(a.COMBOTOTALPRICE) AS TOTALPRICE FROM RES_ADDED_ITEM a WHERE a.ADDEDID = #{id} AND a.OWNCENTER = #{ownCenter} AND a.MODELTYPE = 1 GROUP BY a.MODELCONFIG,a.MODELCONFIGNAME,a.COMBOTOTALPRICE

SELECT #{ownCenterName} || '中心' AS OWNCENTERNAME, 'Paas套餐' AS TYPE, a.MODELCONFIGNAME AS DESCRIPTION, COUNT(a.MODELCONFIG) AS COUNT, a.COMBOTOTALPRICE AS PRICE, SUM(a.COMBOTOTALPRICE) AS TOTALPRICE FROM RES_ADDED_ITEM a WHERE a.ADDEDID = #{id} AND a.OWNCENTER = #{ownCenter} AND a.MODELTYPE = 3 AND a.NODETYPE in ('2','3','5') GROUP BY a.MODELCONFIG,a.MODELCONFIGNAME,a.COMBOTOTALPRICE

SELECT #{ownCenterName} || '中心' AS OWNCENTERNAME, '专用设备套餐' AS TYPE, a.MODELCONFIGNAME AS DESCRIPTION, COUNT(a.MODELCONFIG) AS COUNT, a.COMBOTOTALPRICE AS PRICE, SUM(a.COMBOTOTALPRICE) AS TOTALPRICE FROM RES_ADDED_ITEM a WHERE a.ADDEDID = #{id} AND a.OWNCENTER = #{ownCenter} AND a.MODELTYPE = 4 GROUP BY a.MODELCONFIG,a.MODELCONFIGNAME,a.COMBOTOTALPRICE

SELECT #{ownCenterName} || '中心' AS OWNCENTERNAME, '物理机配件' AS TYPE, a.DESCRIBE AS DESCRIPTION, sum(a.num) AS COUNT, a.price, sum(a.totalprice) AS TOTALPRICE FROM RES_ADDED_ITEM_PARTS a LEFT JOIN RES_ADDED_ITEM b ON a.ADDEDITEMID = b.ID WHERE a.ADDEDID = #{id} AND b.OWNCENTER = #{ownCenter} AND b.MODELTYPE = 1 GROUP BY a.PARTID,a.DESCRIBE,a.PRICE

SELECT #{ownCenterName} || '中心' AS OWNCENTERNAME, 'SAN' AS TYPE, b.APPLYSCENE AS DESCRIPTION, SUM(a.STORAGESIZE) AS COUNT, a.sanprice AS PRICE, 0 AS TOTALPRICE FROM RES_ADDED_ITEM a LEFT JOIN RES_CONFIG_COMBO b ON a.SANID = b.ID WHERE a.ADDEDID = #{id} AND a.OWNCENTER = #{ownCenter} GROUP BY a.SANID,a.SANPRICE,b.APPLYSCENE

SELECT #{ownCenterName} || '中心' AS OWNCENTERNAME, '归档SAN' AS TYPE, b.APPLYSCENE AS DESCRIPTION, SUM(a.SANSPECIALSIZE) AS COUNT, a.SANSPECIALPRICE AS PRICE, 0 AS TOTALPRICE FROM RES_ADDED_ITEM a LEFT JOIN RES_CONFIG_COMBO b ON a.SANSPECIALID = b.ID WHERE a.ADDEDID = #{id} and a.OWNCENTER = #{ownCenter} GROUP BY a.SANSPECIALID,a.SANSPECIALPRICE,b.APPLYSCENE

SELECT #{ownCenterName} || '中心' AS OWNCENTERNAME, 'NAS' AS TYPE, b.APPLYSCENE AS DESCRIPTION, SUM(a.NASSIZE) AS COUNT, a.NASPRICE AS PRICE, SUM(a.NASTOTALPRICE) AS TOTALPRICE FROM RES_ADDED_ITEM a LEFT JOIN RES_CONFIG_COMBO b ON a.MOUNTTYPE = b.ID WHERE a.ADDEDID = #{id} AND a.OWNCENTER = #{ownCenter} GROUP BY a.MOUNTTYPE,a.NASPRICE,a.NASTOTALPRICE,b.APPLYSCENE

SELECT #{ownCenterName} || '中心' AS OWNCENTERNAME, 'db云' AS TYPE, '数据库容量' AS DESCRIPTION, sum(a.DBSIZE) AS COUNT, a.DBPRICE AS PRICE, sum(a.DBTOTALPRICE) AS TOTALPRICE FROM RES_ADDED_ITEM a WHERE a.ADDEDID = #{id} AND a.OWNCENTER = #{ownCenter} AND a.MODELTYPE = 3 AND a.NODETYPE = 3 GROUP BY a.MODELCONFIG,a.DBPRICE

SELECT #{ownCenterName} || '中心' AS OWNCENTERNAME, NAME AS TYPE, VERSION AS DESCRIPTION, NUM AS COUNT, PRICE, TOTALPRICE FROM ( SELECT b.SOFTNAME AS NAME, b.SOFTVERSION AS VERSION, a.OSPRICE AS PRICE, SUM(a.OSTOTALPRICE) AS TOTALPRICE, COUNT(a.OS) AS NUM FROM RES_ADDED_ITEM a LEFT JOIN res_config_soft b ON a.OS = b.ID WHERE a.ADDEDID = #{id} AND a.owncenter = #{ownCenter} GROUP BY a.os,b.SOFTNAME,b.SOFTVERSION,a.OSPRICE
UNION ALL
SELECT a.NAME, a.VERSION, a.PRICE, SUM(a.TOTALPRICE) AS TOTALPRICE, COUNT(a.SOFTID) AS NUM FROM RES_ADDED_ITEM_VERSION a LEFT JOIN RES_ADDED_ITEM b ON a.ADDEDITEMID=b.ID WHERE a.ADDEDID = #{id} AND b.OWNCENTER = #{ownCenter} AND a.PRICE != 0 GROUP BY a.SOFTID,a.NAME,a.VERSION,a.PRICE )

SELECT n.DICTNAME || '中心' AS OWNCENTERNAME, m.NODENAME AS NODENAME, n1.DICTNAME AS NODETYPENAME, n2.DICTNAME AS MODELTYPENAME, '/' AS MODELCONFIG, m.NASSIZE, m.SANSIZE, m.SANSPECIALSIZE, m.DBSIZE FROM ( SELECT a.OWNCENTER, a.NODETYPE, a.MODELTYPE, a.NODENAME, SUM(a.NASSIZE) AS NASSIZE, SUM(a.STORAGESIZE) AS SANSIZE, SUM(a.SANSPECIALSIZE) AS SANSPECIALSIZE, SUM(a.DBSIZE) AS DBSIZE FROM RES_ADDED_ITEM a WHERE a.ADDEDID = #{id} GROUP BY a.NODETYPE,a.MODELTYPE,a.NODENAME,a.ID,a.OWNCENTER,a.OS,a.MODELCONFIG,a.DBSIZE ) m LEFT JOIN EOS_DICT_ENTRY n ON m.OWNCENTER = n.DICTID LEFT JOIN EOS_DICT_ENTRY n1 ON m.NODETYPE = n1.DICTID LEFT JOIN EOS_DICT_ENTRY n2 on m.MODELTYPE = n2.DICTID WHERE n.DICTTYPEID = 'RES_OWNCENTER' AND n1.DICTTYPEID = 'RES_NODETYPE' AND n2.DICTTYPEID = 'RES_MODELTYPE'

SELECT a.ID, a.NODENAME, b.DICTNAME || '中心' AS OWNCENTERNAME, c.DICTNAME AS NODETYPENAME, d.DICTNAME as MODELTYPENAME FROM ( SELECT ID,NODENAME,OWNCENTER,NODETYPE,MODELTYPE FROM RES_ADDED_ITEM WHERE ADDEDID = #{id} ORDER BY OWNCENTER ) a LEFT JOIN EOS_DICT_ENTRY b ON a.OWNCENTER = b.DICTID LEFT JOIN EOS_DICT_ENTRY c ON a.NODETYPE = c.DICTID LEFT JOIN EOS_DICT_ENTRY d on a.MODELTYPE = d.DICTID WHERE b.DICTTYPEID = 'RES_OWNCENTER' AND c.DICTTYPEID = 'RES_NODETYPE' AND d.DICTTYPEID = 'RES_MODELTYPE' GROUP BY a.ID,a.NODENAME,b.DICTNAME,c.DICTNAME,d.DICTNAME

SELECT TO_CHAR(WM_CONCAT(SOFT)) AS SOFT FROM ( SELECT WM_CONCAT(b.NAME || ' ' || b.VERSION || '*' || COUNT(b.ID)) AS SOFT FROM RES_ADDED_ITEM_VERSION b WHERE b.ADDEDITEMID = #{id} GROUP BY b.VERSION,b.NAME UNION All SELECT WM_CONCAT(n.SOFTNAME || ' ' || n.SOFTVERSION || '*1') AS SOFT FROM RES_ADDED_ITEM m LEFT JOIN RES_CONFIG_SOFT n ON m.OS = n.ID WHERE m.ID=#{id} )

SELECT TO_CHAR(WM_CONCAT(PART)) AS PART FROM ( SELECT WM_CONCAT(m.MODELCONFIGNAME || '*1') AS PART FROM RES_ADDED_ITEM m WHERE m.ID = #{id} UNION ALL SELECT WM_CONCAT(b.APPLYSCENE || '*' || SUM(b.NUM)) AS PART FROM RES_ADDED_ITEM_PARTS b WHERE b.ADDEDITEMID = #{id} AND b.applyscene IS NOT NULL GROUP BY b.PARTID,b.APPLYSCENE,b.NUM UNION ALL SELECT WM_CONCAT( Upper( c.dictname) || '(' || b.describe || ')*' || SUM(b.NUM)) AS PART FROM RES_ADDED_ITEM_PARTS b LEFT JOIN EOS_DICT_ENTRY c ON b.RESCONFIGID = c.DICTID WHERE b.ADDEDITEMID = #{id} AND b.APPLYSCENE IS NULL AND c.DICTTYPEID = 'RES_VM_TYPE' GROUP BY b.PARTID,b.DESCRIBE,b.NUM,c.DICTNAME )
mapper.update: UPDATE RES_ADDED_ITEM SET ISCMDBUSED = '1' WHERE ADDEDID = (SELECT ID FROM RES_ADDED WHERE id = #{id} AND RENEWPROCESSNO IS NOT NULL)
mapper.select: SELECT t.compid FROM comm_employee t WHERE t.badge =#{userid}
SELECT * FROM RES_ADDED_ITEM where id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE RES_ADDED SET PROCESSINSTID = #{processInstID}, STATUS = #{status}, AMOUNT = ( SELECT SUM(a.PRICE) FROM RES_ADDED_ITEM a WHERE a.ADDEDID= #{id} ) WHERE ID = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT a.ID, b.DICTNAME || '-' || c.dictname || '-' || a.NODENAME AS NAME FROM RES_ADDED_ITEM a LEFT JOIN EOS_DICT_ENTRY b ON a.NODETYPE = b.DICTID LEFT JOIN EOS_DICT_ENTRY c ON a.MODELTYPE = c.DICTID WHERE a.ADDEDID=#{id} AND b.DICTTYPEID = 'RES_NODETYPE' AND c.DICTTYPEID = 'RES_MODELTYPE'

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT m.SOFTID AS CONFIGID, m.NAME || ' ' || m.VERSION AS DESCRIPTION FROM RES_ADDED_ITEM_VERSION m LEFT JOIN RES_CONFIG_SOFT n ON m.SOFTID = n.ID WHERE m.ADDEDITEMID = #{id} AND n.ISCANCEL = 1 UNION SELECT m.PARTID AS CONFIGID, n.APPLYSCENE AS DESCRIPTION FROM RES_ADDED_ITEM_PARTS m LEFT JOIN ( SELECT m.ISCANCEL, m.ID, '【' || n.DICTNAME || '】' || m.APPLYSCENE AS APPLYSCENE FROM RES_CONFIG_COMBO m LEFT JOIN EOS_DICT_ENTRY n ON m.SUBCATEGORY = n.DICTID WHERE n.DICTTYPEID = 'RES_SUBCATEGORY' UNION SELECT m.ISCANCEL, m.ID, n.DICTNAME || '(' || m.DESCRIBE || ')' AS APPLYSCENE FROM RES_CONFIG_VM m LEFT JOIN EOS_DICT_ENTRY n ON m.TYPE = n.dictid WHERE n.DICTTYPEID = 'RES_VM_TYPE' ) n ON m.PARTID = n.id WHERE m.ADDEDITEMID = #{id} AND n.ISCANCEL =1 UNION SELECT m.MOUNTTYPE AS CONFIGID, n.APPLYSCENE AS DESCRIPTION FROM RES_ADDED_ITEM m LEFT JOIN RES_CONFIG_COMBO n ON m.MOUNTTYPE = n.id WHERE m.ID = #{id} AND n.ISCANCEL = 1 UNION SELECT m.OS AS CONFIGID, n.sOFTNAME || ' ' || n.SOFTVERSION AS DESCRIPTION FROM RES_ADDED_ITEM m LEFT JOIN RES_CONFIG_SOFT n ON m.OS = n.ID WHERE m.ID = #{id} AND n.ISCANCEL = 1 UNION SELECT m.MODELCONFIG AS CONFIGID, m.MODELCONFIGNAME AS DESCRIPTION FROM RES_ADDED_ITEM m LEFT JOIN RES_CONFIG_COMBO n ON m.MODELCONFIG = n.id WHERE m.ID = #{id} AND n.ISCANCEL = 1 UNION SELECT m.SANID AS CONFIGID, n.APPLYSCENE AS DESCRIPTION FROM RES_ADDED_ITEM m LEFT JOIN RES_CONFIG_COMBO n ON m.SANID = n.ID WHERE m.ID = #{id} AND n.ISCANCEL = 1 UNION SELECT m.SANSPECIALID AS CONFIGID, n.APPLYSCENE AS DESCRIPTION FROM RES_ADDED_ITEM m LEFT JOIN RES_CONFIG_COMBO n ON m.SANSPECIALID = n.ID WHERE m.ID = #{id} AND n.ISCANCEL = 1 )
